title: The Safari Reef Cull
logline: A luxury orbital hunting lodge seeds live-fire military drones into a scenic ring reef to thrill wealthy tourists, until the weapons malfunction and target civilian yachts.

roles.description: Runs a luxury big-game space safari outfit; smooth-talking promoter who cuts lethal corners on safety.
Chief mechanic at the hunting lodge; exhausted, terrified of a catastrophe, keeping quiet to feed her family.
A cartel of leisure operators providing high-paying orbital entertainment across the sector.
A shimmering crystalline asteroid field marketed as an untouched wilderness for luxury shooting tours.
A decommissioned combat target drone drifting through the ring with live targeting sensors activated.
A coordinated pack of surplus combat drones converging on tourist flight corridors.

public_situation: The luxury safari lodge in {system} reports an unexpected flight pause in the crystalline ring reef due to navigational telemetry recalibration.
private_truth: {role:safari_director} seeded surplus combat target drones into {role:scenic_ring_reef} to simulate beast hunts for rich patrons, but the drones' live combat protocols reactivated.

beats.public_change: The safari lodge issues commercial scan contracts to verify corridor telemetry across the crystalline reef.

missions.reason: He contracts the pilot to scan drone telemetry buoys across the outer reef and certify that the tourist excursion lane is clear of hazards.
missions.private_fact: He knows three surplus drones failed to respond to the remote shutdown beacon before the morning cruise departed.

beats.public_change: Distress pings echo through the reef as an uncrewed target drone begins pinging commercial frequencies with weapon locks.

missions.reason: The director hires the pilot to destroy the rogue target drone and recover its internal telemetry core before authorities detect missile fire.
missions.private_fact: The recovered telemetry core contains flight logs proving {role:resort_syndicate} stripped the drone's safety dampening chips.

beats.public_change: {role:lodge_engineer} establishes private comms with the pilot, begging for the recovered core before it can be incinerated.

missions.reason: The director pays the pilot to purchase industrial signal jamming arrays and rush them to the reef to blind local maritime radar.
missions.private_fact: Activating the jammer will cut emergency distress channels for every civilian transport in the sector.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the telemetry core and jamming gear. {role:lodge_engineer} wants the core delivered to port inspectors, while {role:safari_director} demands the swarm be suppressed.

options.label: Hand the telemetry core to the lodge engineer
Help the director destroy the remaining swarm

beats.public_change: A swarm of rearmed target drones converges on the luxury viewing platform in the center of the reef.

missions.reason: The engineer hires the pilot to destroy the combat drone swarm attacking the tourist barge before the observation hull breaches.
missions.private_fact: The excursion barge carries the families of high-ranking system magistrates who believe they are participating in a game.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the strike swarm, and the director covers up the malfunction with hush money.
resolutions.summary: The combat drones are eliminated in the reef. {role:safari_director} buries the incident with payouts, while {role:lodge_engineer} resigns in disgust.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot shot down rogue combat drones in the tourist reef and kept quiet about the owner.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands the telemetry core to the engineer, who delivers the proof to safety inspectors.
resolutions.summary: {role:lodge_engineer} delivers the telemetry core to authorities. {role:safari_director} is arrested for manslaughter, and the hunting lodge is shut down.

resolutions.reached_by: The drones breach the viewing barge, or the pilot abandons the fight.
resolutions.summary: The rogue swarm ravages the tourist barge. {role:scenic_ring_reef} is declared an exclusion zone, and {role:resort_syndicate} suffers disastrous losses.

loose_threads.detail: The drone warhead crating is stenciled with surplus lot numbers belonging to a decommissioned planetary militia.
The lodge director's offshore account received a series of structured deposits from a scrap yard factor.
Exclusive commercial shooting leases for the entire ring system were secured by a single syndicate holding firm.

radio_hooks: Sightseeing flights into {role:scenic_ring_reef} temporarily delayed for scheduled telemetry sweep.
Maritime safety board launches surprise inspection of luxury big-game outfitters in {system}.
Frontier lodge promises unmatched excitement on newly expanded orbital safari packages.

voice_direction.safari_director: Rapid, theatrical sales patter loaded with patronizing charm. Glides over lethal hazards by calling them unscripted thrills.
voice_direction.lodge_engineer: Harsh, blunt, and exhausted. Spews technical component numbers under her breath and refuses to make direct eye contact.
